top_issues.text: ROUND-5 FOLLOW-UP DONE (coordinator 2026-06-27 round5-followup-areal-source). Re-ran the H1 occurrence test with the DISPERSED areal lode-source feature (hydrology.distance_to_lode_areal_m to the Nome Group schist polygons PzZh/Ocs/Dcs/Zn/Zo, 0 inside; schist = 15.5% of district land, median dist-to-schist 3.1 km) and the PROPER schist-carbonate contact derived in PR #49, after settling the DOx unit. DOx RESOLVED against USGS SIM 3131 (Till 2011, which uses the same DOx label): DOx = 'Mixed marble, graphitic metasiliceous rock, and schist (Devonian-Ordovician)', structurally below the Casadepaga Schist -- NOT a carbonate platform. The clean marbles Oim+Pzmm sit 11-33 km OUTSIDE the district DEM, so the clean schist-carbonate contact (10.3 km) is regional (Phase-2) and within the district the only carbonate-bearing unit is the mixed DOx. Tested the contact both ways (contact_dox 154.8 km in-AOI; contact_clean 10.3 km, an off-AOI 25 km ramp). VERDICT: NEITHER the areal feature NOR the proper contact survives the leak-guarded spatial CV. Full-AOI H1a is confounded by the upland-vs-coastal split (all features clear the random-point null p95 0.640 and torus null p95 0.665 on rank AUC; strict RF-CV>0.5 met only at the margin by straight 0.575 and contact_clean 0.555 CI-low 0.502, the latter just the regional ramp). Upland-matched H1b (the confound-free control) is null across the board: areal 0.381 (rank inverts to 0.449, the schist source is everywhere in the uplands), contact_dox 0.423, contact_clean 0.498, straight 0.558 (CI spans 0.5), prebuilt 0.497. Sub-results: the derived contact beats the prebuilt in-sample (rank 0.705 vs 0.649) and does NOT invert under RF (0.554 vs the prebuilt 0.344, resolving round-5's sign-inversion into a clean null); marine control null (areal rank 0.444). Same answer as round 5: local-source at Nome is in coarseness vs distance (round-5 H2 rho -0.40), not occurrence; the clean contact belongs to the peninsula scale-up. Also re-merged PR #49 (unioned status.json against the round-5 PR #48 on origin/main). PR off origin/main (branch phase2/peninsula-acquire-2026-06-27); deliverables under data/derived/nome_placer/inland_local_source/ (2 new feature rasters + results json + csv + REPORT addendum); pipeline scripts/nome_placer/inland_local_source/run_areal_contact_followup.py. No prod promotion. Voice-clean (0 banned / 0 dash).

ROUND 5 INLAND-ALLUVIAL LOCAL-SOURCE TEST DONE (coordinator 2026-06-27, Nome district only). Typed the 60 ARDF placer occurrences inside the DEM extent -> 51 strictly-alluvial / 6 marine-beach / 3 district aggregates dropped (residual-eluvial filtered at source to kill the distance-zero tautology). Built DEM hydrology (25 m IfSAR: depression-fill + D8 receiver network, pointer convention verified 100% downhill), a confined-upland-valley mask (local relief >= 45 m) with a foothill dead-zone, and two lode-distance feature rasters: down-channel (D8 walk downstream from 36a seeds, the DEM adaptation of hydrology.py:distance_downstream_from_lode whose NHD/hydroseq walk does not apply; placer-leak guard carried, 2 placer-coded seeds dropped) and straight-line. VERDICT (leak-guarded spatial CV = KMeans blocks + 300 m buffer, bootstrap CI throughout): (1) down-channel to a mapped 36a lode NOT TESTABLE: the mapped discrete-lode inventory is too sparse/disconnected from the confined network (only 6/51 alluvial sit in a confined valley downstream of any lode; 1/51 exactly on a channel cell). Next instrument is the dispersed-source areal feature (distance_to_lode_areal_m) or mineralized-schist polygons. (2) schist-limestone contact is NULL at Nome (rank AUC 0.649 vs random-point null p95 0.640; RF spatial-CV 0.34, sign-inverted; consistent with the spec's own 'sparse at Nome, Phase-2 peninsula' note). (3) straight-line distance shows a proximity association that does NOT survive spatial CV (rank AUC 0.74 full-AOI / 0.71 upland-matched, but RF upland-matched 0.52): placers and lodes co-occur in the same sub-basins, no transferable law -- the F1 leakage lesson again. (4) H2 POSITIVE and the clearest result: gold coarseness falls with straight-line distance to lode (Spearman rho = -0.40, p = 0.042; rough 911 m / coarse 4354 m / fine 5008 m), the Collier-1908/Tuck-1942 downstream-fining gradient, though n = 26 text-mined ordinal tags and not spatially cross-validated. (5) negative control clean (marine null on both features, CIs span 0.5; no AOI occurrence types as glacial-drift). PR off origin/main (branch round5/inland-alluvial-local-source-2026-06-27); deliverables force-added under data/derived/nome_placer/inland_local_source/ (typed geojson, 2 feature rasters, h1_h2_results.json, REPORT.md, CSVs); pipeline under scripts/nome_placer/inland_local_source/. No prod promotion. Voice-clean (0 banned / 0 dash).

PHASE-2 PENINSULA ACQUISITION + STAGING DONE (coordinator 2026-06-27 phase2-peninsula-acquire handoff; Sky greenlit). Acquisition/staging only, no modeling; queued behind the round-5 Nome test (also done this run). (1) Peninsula ARDF: the full Alaska ARDF shapefile was already on disk (data/raw/ardf/ardf/ardf.shp, EPSG:4267), so no fetch needed. Extracted the 4 Seward Peninsula gold quads and kept placer (39a) + lode (36a), reprojected to WGS84 + 3338: 480 occurrences (402 placer / 78 lode; 421 Au-main) -> NM 150/52, SO 113/14 (Council/Casadepaga/Bluff/Big Hurrah are all in Solomon), BN 74/3, TE 65/9. geol_desc is the 255-char shapefile stub; full narratives are at mrdata per-record JSON (reachable) if Phase-2 typing needs them. (2) Schist-limestone contact feasibility: peninsula geology is NOT on disk (only the Nome quad, Bundtzen 1994 nmgeol_dd). On the Nome quad the units ARE cleanly separable (53 schist polys PzZh/Ocs/Zn/Zo/Dcs vs 25 carbonate DOx/Oim/Pzmm) and the schist-carbonate contact is derivable via shared dissolved boundaries. KEY CAVEAT: the contact length is 154.8 km WITH the DOx unit but only 10.3 km without it (DOx is the largest non-schist unit, ~144 of 155 km), so the result hinges on the DOx assignment -- classed carbonate by map-code + D-O age, must be confirmed against the unit legend before peninsula scale-up. NOTE FOR ROUND 5: the prebuilt dist_to_contact.tif round 5 used is NOT this schist-carbonate contact (Spearman 0.53; median 1389 m vs 4214 m), so round 5's contact-null is about that denser prebuilt layer; re-running round-5's contact feature against this derived contact is a cheap follow-up. GAP: Solomon/Bendeleben/Teller bedrock geology must be pulled (USGS SIM 3131 if peninsula-wide, else AK DGGS / Till 2011 compilation) for the full Phase-2. ROUND 4B DRIFT-ON-BEACH = FINAL NULL (coordinator 2026-06-27 nome-round4B-digitize-drift-contact handoff). The strandline-by-drift placer lever, data-walled in rounds 3 and 4 (AOF 125 and RI 2024-6 both lie east of the placer ground), reopened on the precise Nome-town source USGS MF-247 (Hummel 1962, Nome C-1, 1:63,360). MF-247 maps the coastal plain as one undifferentiated unit (no drift-vs-beach edge), so the digitizable boundary is the bedrock (Nome Group) / Quaternary-cover contact, a drift-source-proximity proxy. Georeferenced MF-247 to EPSG:3338 on its 4 graticule neatline corners (RMS ~20 m; scripts/nome_placer/mf247_georeference.py, corners visually confirmed against the printed graticule labels). Overlap gate: 58 of 65 placer positives inside the C-1 footprint (the 7 outside are south of the coastline), so unlike the eastern maps it covers the ground. Contact vector = inland edge of the SIM 3131 (1:500k) coastal-plain Qs polygon clipped to C-1; the scanned MF-247 cannot be hand-traced in an unattended run, so the clean digital GeMS line stands in and MF-247 is staged for the manual-digitize precision upgrade. Feature = distance to (raised strandline x contact), F1 leak-guarded CV: marginal AUC -0.030 (CI [-0.072,+0.011], P(d>0)=0.07), inside-C1 -0.031 (CI [-0.070,+0.009]); plain distance-to-contact -0.016. The proxy adds nothing over the beach-line base; the drift effect, if present, is already inside the strandline score. Deliverables at data/derived/nome_placer/bedrock_contact/ (vector + SOURCE.md + REPORT.md + JSON/CSV + figure); scripts/nome_placer/{mf247_georeference,placer_bedrock_contact_cv}.py.
